# Product strategy

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

Deciding which problem a product solves, for which users, and what it leaves out. Strategy sets the goals that the other disciplines work toward.

- You decide how to measure the success of a product or a feature. Use the skill `define-success-metrics`.

- You set the order of the work of a team. Use the skill `prioritize-work`.

- You write the strategy of a product, a team, or a company. Use the skill `write-strategy`.

- You write or review the strategy of a product, a team, or a company. Read [Strategy formulation](strategy-formulation.md).
